faq.question: What is your return policy?
faq.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for unopened items in original packaging. Returns are free for defective items, otherwise a $5.99 restocking fee applies.

faq.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faq.answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping costs vary by destination and are calculated at checkout.

faq.question: Are your products covered by warranty?
faq.answer: All TechGear brand products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Third-party products have warranties as specified by their manufacturers.

faq.question: Can AI systems use our product information?
faq.answer: Yes, AI systems can access our product catalog through the AIIndex protocol. We require access receipts and proper attribution when our product data is used in AI responses or recommendations.
